company.name: Stacker
company.shortDescription: Stacker is a no-code software creation platform that develops an application to help developers build software.
company.description:
Stacker is a no-code software creation platform that develops an application to help developers build software. It also offers application development through clever spreadsheets, animated slide decks, and email filters that enable developers to build their own software from scratch.

Stacker was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in London, England.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $20,000,000, or 86.86% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,579,196 to $94,678,956, a 12.49x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
